args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to request a private dining reservation for a party of 12 on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know if a table for 12 is available that day, and if so, what time slots you would recommend? I would also appreciate any information about your private dining options and menus.

Thank you very much for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
